summary: Adds solved, editable sketch graphs with exact constraints, dimensions, Trim/Extend/Split/Offset/Mirror and shared command sessions, plus faster review checks and naming rules.
warning: Installed machine/post packages, saved revisions and controller output remain compatible. Potentially breaking for CAD files: saving a sketch graph upgrades a CAD document to schema 2, which earlier app versions cannot open; the schema 1 original is preserved when the upgrade is saved. Trim and Extend now remove a detached endpoint that no entity or relation still uses.

checklist.schema: CAD documents gain schema 2 with optional sketch graphs (points, entities, relations). Schema 1 documents still open unchanged and are only upgraded on an explicit save that preserves the original. No CAM manifest, UPID, post schema or engine API changes.
checklist.events: Post execution, simulation and existing WebMCP operations keep their validation and events. New CAD sketch edits run through the shared prepared-edit path with cancellation and input-version checks. CAD tool discovery stays below the 50 KiB budget; edit and proposal contracts are described on demand and validated in full before execution.
checklist.capabilities: No machine or post capability changes. New sketch edits and region inspections are additive CAD operations that older apps do not offer.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line endings, feed or controller-file behavior changes.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package or revision migration. Browser cache and folder storage share the CAD schema 2 save path and preserve exact schema 1 originals. No unreferenced file cleanup.
checklist.verification: Local full pure-domain (125 files, 1255 tests) and browser (368 files, 3938 tests) suites, type-check, shared UI gate and documentation check pass. Far-origin probes confirm position-independent tangency in cells and trims, exact re-solve checks at large coordinates and a precise split rejection. Review checks now run contracts, two unit shards and two browser-journey shards in parallel and verify branch and title naming.

publicNotes.summary: Draw, constrain and edit exact sketch geometry before turning it into solid features.
changes: Sketches keep editable points, lines, arcs and circles with solved constraints and dimensions.
Trim, extend, split, offset, mirror, fillet and chamfer edit sketch geometry exactly.
Sketch commands share one consistent form with live previews and cancel safely.
Agents discover sketch edit contracts on demand and can preview regions before editing.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output remain compatible. CAD files saved with sketch graphs need this app version or later.
publicNotes.action: Keep an exported copy of a CAD part before saving sketch edits if you still need to open it in an older app version.
